title: FX Senshi Kurumi-chan

thread.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan • FX Senshi Kurumi-chan - Episode 7 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers found Mochiko compelling as a calculating, morally awful character, while still enjoying her role in the episode.
Several commenters admired Mochiko’s sharper understanding of trading and her unusual relationship with Kurumi, but strongly disliked her manipulative treatment of Mebuki.
Mebuki drew substantial criticism for greed, poor probability reasoning, and continuing risky behavior despite mounting consequences.
Yasuko was widely praised as the most grounded and sensible character, with viewers especially supportive of her creative interests.
Some viewers enjoyed the dark comedy and exaggerated finance discussions, while others found the characters’ decisions frustrating and stressful.
A recurring complaint was that the episode presents reckless financial behavior as increasingly bleak, with little sympathy for several characters.
